archetypes.name: dyn-dispatch-contract
archetypes.rationale: Wire-contract preservation for voter KV order and paths-file policy across both dispatch families.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on the voter KV emission order contract in dispatch_shared.py emit_final_voter_kvs. Verify that code_review_sequential and plan_review_interleaved produce exactly the same 14 VOTER_* keys as the original implementations, with VOTER_PATHS_FILE in the correct position for each layout and the paths_file_policy gates intact. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
